name: Multi-planar volumetric 3D display
definition: A volumetric 3D display technique that projects 2D image patterns onto a moving screen to form a stack of spatial images along the Z-axis, creating a true 3D image in space viewable without glasses.
summary: A multi-planar volumetric 3D display projects 2D images onto a linearly moving screen to create a glasses-free 3D volume with true physiological depth cues.
